# powerdns_dnsdist_acl (Resource)

dnsdist's `allow-from` ACL — the only configuration dnsdist's API can write.

Rules, pools, downstream servers and dynamic blocks are Lua or YAML and have no HTTP path at all ([ADR 0006](https://github.com/ioplane/terraform-provider-powerdns/blob/main/docs/adr/0006-dnsdist-scope.md)). This resource and a cache flush are the whole of what a provider can do.

Needs `setAPIWritable(true, dir)` in the Lua configuration; `apiConfigDir` alone is not enough, and without it every `PUT` answers 405.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The only configuration dnsdist's API can write. Rules, pools, downstream
# servers and dynamic blocks are Lua or YAML and have no HTTP path at all.
#
# Needs setAPIWritable(true, dir) in the Lua configuration; apiConfigDir alone
# is not enough, and without it every PUT answers 405.

resource "powerdns_dnsdist_acl" "clients" {
  netmasks = ["10.0.0.0/8", "127.0.0.0/8", "::1/128"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `netmasks` (List of String) The netmasks, compared as subnets and ignoring order.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Fixed: dnsdist has one ACL.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# dnsdist has one ACL, so the id is fixed.
terraform import powerdns_dnsdist_acl.clients allow-from
```
